body:
Into the mighty jungle the mighty jungle the lion sleeps tonight....
a weeee bum bum ummaway.... Jungle Blitz! (Credit to Zintenka for the name)

My 2nd Map i've ever made and i did it in between 1am to 7am (ik somethings wrong with me when it
